DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご同行の方をお待ちですか。展示へ入る前の待ち合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for someone you came with? Are you meeting before entering the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と別々に展示を見ます。出口が違ったら会えなくなりそうなので、集合場所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と展示を別々に見て出口が違うと会えないため集合場所を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I will look around the exhibition separately. I'm worried we won't find each other if we use different exits, so I'd like to choose a meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you and your friend will view the exhibition separately and want to choose a meeting place because different exits could prevent you from finding each other. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの受付前なら、展示を見終えた後にも戻れます。お二人で同じ場所を見ておくと分かりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can return to the area in front of this reception desk after viewing the exhibition. It will be easier if both of you look at the same place beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内板の横ですね。座って待てる場所のほうがよいのですが、近くに椅子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板を確認し近くに待てる椅子があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside this information board, right? I'd prefer somewhere we can sit while waiting. Are there any chairs nearby?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the information board and ask whether there are chairs nearby where you can wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の向かいに椅子があります。人が増えても、案内板が見える位置を目印にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are chairs opposite reception. Even if it gets crowded, you can use a spot where you can see the information board as your landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では椅子のところにします。友人が先に来たら、職員さんに私への伝言を預けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 椅子で集合し友人が先に来たとき伝言を預けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then we'll meet by the chairs. If my friend gets here first, can they leave a message for me with a staff member?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the chairs as your meeting place and ask whether your friend can leave a message if they arrive first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個人の伝言はお預かりしていません。直接連絡できる方法を、お二人で決めておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't hold personal messages. Please agree between yourselves on a way to contact each other directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 館内では電話を避けたいので、終わったらメッセージを送ります。電波が弱い場合はどうしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示終了後のメッセージを選び電波が弱い場合を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd rather not make phone calls inside, so I'll send a message when I'm finished. What should we do if the signal is weak?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to send a message after viewing the exhibition and ask what to do if the signal is weak. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届かなくても集合場所へ戻る、と先に約束しておくとよいですね。展示内で通話する必要もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be good to agree beforehand that you'll return to the meeting place even if the message doesn't arrive. Then you won't need to make a call inside the exhibition either.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人と今ここを確認します。十六時に椅子へ戻り、早く終わればメッセージだけ送ると決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人と場所を確認し十六時帰着と早期終了時のメッセージを約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check this spot with my friend now. We'll agree to return to the chairs at four, and only send a message if we finish early.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the place with your friend and agree to return at four and send a message if you finish early. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人とも同じ場所を確認できたら安心ですね。どうぞご見学ください。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can relax once you've both checked the same place. Please enjoy the exhibition. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の道をお探しでしょうか。ベビーカーで通る予定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a route through the park? You'll be using a stroller, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。下り坂なら押せますが、帰りに同じ坂を上れるか心配です。平らな道で一周できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーで帰りの上り坂が心配なため平坦な一周経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can push it downhill, but I'm worried about getting back up the same hill. Is there a flat route that makes a full circuit?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a flat circular route because you're worried about pushing the stroller uphill on the way back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図では、奥まで一周すると坂が入ります。手前の広場を往復するほうが傾斜は少ないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, a full circuit to the far end includes a slope. Going to the nearby plaza and back involves less of an incline.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一周にはこだわりません。手前の広場に子どもと座って休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周は不要と伝え手前の広場のベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't need to make a full circuit. Is there somewhere in the nearby plaza where I can sit and rest with my child?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that a full circuit isn't necessary and ask about benches in the nearby plaza. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベンチがあります。ベビーカーは通路をふさがない位置に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are benches. Please park the stroller somewhere it won't block the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で子どもが眠ったら、そのまま引き返したいです。戻る道で階段を通らずに済みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもが眠ったら階段を通らず引返せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: If my child falls asleep on the way, I'd like to turn straight back. Can I get back without using any stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can turn back without using stairs if your child falls asleep. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行きと同じ広い道を戻れば階段はありません。横道の階段へ入らないよう、地図に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are no stairs if you return along the same wide path you took there. I'll mark the map so you don't take the stairs on a side path.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。雨が降ってきたら、近くにしばらく待てる屋根のある場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨が降った際の屋根のある休憩場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. If it starts raining, is there somewhere nearby with a roof where we can wait for a while?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a sheltered place to rest if it rains. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この地図には休憩用の屋根付きスペースがあります。ただ、激しく降るときは無理に先へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: This map shows a covered rest area. But if it rains heavily, please don't force yourself to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場を往復して、眠ったら同じ道を戻ります。雨が強くなる前に屋根のある場所で様子を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場を往復し睡眠や雨の強さに応じて戻るか屋根で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll go to the plaza and back, returning along the same path if my child falls asleep. We'll wait under cover and see how things look before the rain gets heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you'll go to the plaza and back, returning or waiting under cover depending on your child's sleep and the strength of the rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰りの分も余裕を残してお歩きください。どうぞお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please leave yourself enough energy for the return journey. Take care. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計ですね。こちらがご注文の明細です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're ready to pay? Here is the itemized bill for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 炒飯と春巻きは食べましたが、この小籠包はまだ来ていません。料金も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 炒飯と春巻きは食べたが小籠包が来ていないと明細を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: We've had the fried rice and spring rolls, but these soup dumplings haven't arrived yet. Are they included in the charge too?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the bill, explaining that you've eaten the fried rice and spring rolls but the soup dumplings haven't arrived. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明細には入っていますね。厨房へ提供状況を確認します。小籠包の到着をお待ちでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are on the bill. I'll check with the kitchen whether they've been served. Were you waiting for the soup dumplings?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待っていましたが、そろそろ出たいです。まだ作っていなければ取り消したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退出時刻が近いためまだ作っていなければ小籠包を取り消したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: We were, but we'd like to leave soon. If they haven't been made yet, we'd like to cancel them.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you need to leave soon and would like to cancel the soup dumplings if they haven't been made yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、注文が厨房へ正しく伝わっておらず、まだ作っていませんでした。取り消しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked, and the order wasn't passed to the kitchen correctly, so they haven't been made yet. We can cancel them.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では小籠包は取り消してください。飲み物二杯と料理二品だけの会計に直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小籠包を取り消し飲物二杯と料理二品に直してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please cancel the soup dumplings. Could you change the bill to just the two drinks and the two dishes?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to cancel the soup dumplings and change the bill to two drinks and two dishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、訂正します。春巻きは二人前のご注文でしたので、明細は二人前の数量です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll correct it. You ordered two servings of spring rolls, so the quantity on the bill is two servings.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 春巻きは二人前で合っています。訂正した合計を、支払う前にもう一度見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 春巻き二人前は正しく支払前に訂正合計を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two servings of spring rolls is correct. Please show me the corrected total again before I pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that two servings of spring rolls is correct and say you want to see the corrected total before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが訂正後の明細です。小籠包は除いてあります。お支払いを一緒になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the corrected itemized bill. The soup dumplings have been removed. Would you like to pay together?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 訂正を確認しました。二人分まとめてカードで払います。レシートも一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正を確認し二人分をカードでまとめて払いレシート一枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the correction. I'll pay for both of us together by card. Please give me one receipt as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the correction, say you'll pay for both people together by card, and request one receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一枚でお渡しします。お待たせして申し訳ありませんでした。ご来店ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you one receipt. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. Thank you for visiting. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を差し支えない範囲で教えてください。今、お金を渡すよう求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you'd like to discuss, as far as you're comfortable sharing. Are you currently being asked to hand over money?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない会社から何度も電話が来て、今日中に払えと言われています。対面で相談するには予約がいりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない会社から当日払いを要求され対面相談の予約要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: A company I don't know keeps calling and telling me to pay today. Do I need an appointment for an in-person consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an unfamiliar company is demanding payment today and ask whether an appointment is needed for an in-person consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず担当へ内容を伝えます。電話の相手が今、ご自宅へ向かうと言っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll first pass the details to the person in charge. Is the caller saying they're heading to your home now?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来るとは言っていません。振込先だけ送られてきましたが、まだ払っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問予告はなく振込先だけ届きまだ払っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: They haven't said they're coming. They've only sent bank transfer details, and I haven't paid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there has been no notice of a visit, only bank transfer details, and you haven't paid yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 払う前に相談しましょう。担当の相談時間を確認します。通話の履歴や届いたメッセージは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's arrange a consultation before you pay. I'll check the consultation hours. Do you still have the call history and the messages you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っています。会社の休憩時間に来たいのですが、最初の説明だけ電話でもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 履歴が残り会社休憩時間に電話で最初の説明ができるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I do. I'd like to come during my break at work, but could I give the initial explanation by phone instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you still have the records and ask whether you can give the initial explanation by phone during your work break. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口から相談担当につなげます。電話で聞き取れる内容と、来署が必要な内容を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: This desk can connect you to the consultation staff. We'll clarify which details can be taken by phone and which require you to come to the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族のいる場所で話しにくいので、折り返しの時間を指定できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族のいる場所では話しづらく電話時刻を指定したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's hard to talk where my family is, so could I specify a time for the return call?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it's difficult to talk with your family around and that you want to specify a time for the call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へ希望を伝えられます。ただ、必ずその時刻になるとは約束できません。出られる時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can pass your preference to the staff member. However, we can't promise the call will be at that exact time. Please tell me the times when you can answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の十二時半から十三時なら話せます。履歴は消さず、担当者に相談するまで振り込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十二時半から十三時に話せ履歴を残し相談まで振り込まないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can talk from twelve thirty to one today. I'll keep the records and won't transfer any money until I've consulted the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can talk from twelve thirty to one, will keep the records, and won't transfer money before the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その時間帯をお伝えします。相手が来るなど状況が変わったら、すぐにお知らせください。いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on that time window. If the situation changes, such as the caller coming to you, please let us know immediately. I'll say goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬代のお会計は済みました。領収書と明細書をこちらでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Payment for your medicine is complete. Here are your receipt and itemized statement.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会社から病院へ行った証明を求められました。この薬局の領収書で足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 病院へ行った証明に薬局領収書が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. My employer has asked for proof that I went to the hospital. Is this pharmacy receipt enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a pharmacy receipt can be used as proof of a hospital visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは薬局でお支払いいただいた記録です。会社が求める受診証明と同じものかは、会社へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: This records your payment at the pharmacy. You'll need to ask your employer whether it is the same as the proof of a medical visit they require.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察を受けた日と休む期間が書かれたものが必要だそうです。ここで書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察日と休む期間のある書類を薬局で作れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Apparently, they need a document stating the date I saw the doctor and how long I need off. Can you write that here?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the pharmacy can prepare a document stating the consultation date and the period of leave. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察や休養期間の証明は、診察をした医療機関へご相談ください。薬局では診断内容を証明できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consult the medical institution that examined you about proof of the consultation or the required rest period. A pharmacy cannot certify your diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。薬代は自分で記録したいので、明細書と領収書の違いも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬代の記録のため明細書と領収書の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'd like to keep my own record of medicine costs, so please also explain the difference between the itemized statement and the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between the itemized statement and the receipt so you can record medicine costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 領収書は支払額の記録、明細書は費用の内訳を見る書類です。両方そろえて保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: The receipt records the amount paid, while the itemized statement shows the breakdown of costs. You can keep both together.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 病院へ相談するときに、この二枚も持っていったほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬局の二枚を病院への相談にも持参すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I bring these two sheets as well when I consult the hospital?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should also bring the two pharmacy documents when consulting the hospital. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要書類は病院へ確認してください。診察日や薬の情報が分かるものを手元に置いて問い合わせると説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the hospital which documents are needed. It will be easier to explain if you have documents showing the consultation date and medicine information at hand when you contact them.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚は保管します。受診日と休養期間の書類は、会社に名称を聞いてから病院へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を保管し会社へ書類名を聞いた後病院へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep both sheets. I'll ask my employer for the name of the document showing the consultation date and rest period, and then consult the hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep both sheets and consult the hospital after asking your employer for the document's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡しした書類をお忘れなく。ご利用ありがとうございました。お大事に、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please don't forget the documents I've given you. Thank you for visiting. Take care, and goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当箱は、大きさからお選びですか。使い方に合わせて比べられますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing a lunch box by size? You can compare them based on how you'll use them.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ弁当を持ちます。三千円までで、鞄の中で汁が漏れにくいものが欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場用に三千円以内で鞄の中で汁が漏れにくい弁当箱を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I take lunch to work. I'd like one costing no more than three thousand yen that's less likely to leak liquid inside my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for a lunch box for work within three thousand yen that is less likely to leak liquid in your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この二つなら予算内です。片方は留め具があり、もう片方はふたを載せるだけの形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: These two are within your budget. One has clips, while the other simply has a lid that sits on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 量は小さいほうで足りそうですが、留め具があるほうは洗いにくくないですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さい容量で足りるが留め具付きの容器を洗いやすいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: The smaller one seems big enough for my meal, but isn't the one with clips difficult to wash?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the smaller capacity is enough and ask whether the container with clips is easy to wash. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 留め具付きのものは、ふたのパッキンを外して洗えます。戻す向きを間違えないことが大切です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the one with clips, you can remove the lid's seal to wash it. It's important to put it back facing the right way.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外し方を見せてください。力が要ると毎日洗うのが面倒になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎日扱える力でパッキンを外せるか見せてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me how to remove it. If it takes a lot of force, washing it every day might become a hassle.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration of removing the seal to see whether it takes an amount of force you can manage every day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この溝から指で外せます。説明図も付いています。戻した後は、溝に浮きがないか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can remove it with your fingers from this groove. An illustrated guide is included too. After putting it back, check that no part is lifted out of the groove.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 思ったより簡単ですね。この容器を電子レンジで使うときは、ふたを外す必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レンジでふたを外す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's easier than I expected. When using this container in the microwave, do I need to remove the lid?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to remove the lid for microwaving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品の表示では、ふたと留め具を外して本体だけを加熱します。汁物を入れたまま振るのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: According to this product's label, you remove the lid and clips and heat only the container itself. Avoid shaking it with soup or other liquids inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 留め具付きのほうにします。説明図を残し、洗うたびにパッキンを戻して確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 留め具付きを選び説明図を保管し洗浄後の装着を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the one with clips. I'll keep the illustrated guide and check the seal after putting it back each time I wash it.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the one with clips, say you'll keep the illustrated guide, and check that the seal is fitted after washing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示も合わせてお読みください。お買い上げありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please read the label as well. Thank you for your purchase. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前を伺えますか。予約画面もお持ちでしたら確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on the reservation? If you have the reservation screen, I'll check that as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のチャンという名前です。二泊の予約ですが、友人は仕事で今日帰り、私だけ明日まで泊まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チャン名義の二泊予約で友人だけ今日帰り自分は明日まで泊まると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's under my friend Chan's name. We booked two nights, but my friend is leaving today because of work, and only I'll stay until tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two-night reservation is under Chan's name, your friend is leaving today, and you alone will stay until tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約にお客様のお名前が同行者として入っているか確認します。変更の連絡はされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check whether your name is included as an accompanying guest. Have you notified us about the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が今朝電話したと言っています。私は二泊目も泊まれるのか、その記録を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人が朝電話したため二泊目も宿泊可能か記録を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend says they called this morning. Please check that record to see whether I can stay for the second night too.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend called this morning and ask for the record to be checked to confirm whether you can stay the second night. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更連絡の記録を調べます。こちらの予約には二泊ともお客様のお名前が入っています。本人確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll look up the record of the change notification. Your name is on this reservation for both nights. Please provide identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらが在留カードです。友人が全額払ったと言いましたが、私がまた払う必要はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードを示し友人が全額払った宿泊料を自分も払う必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is my residence card. My friend said they paid in full. Do I need to pay again myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your residence card and ask whether you also need to pay the accommodation charge that your friend says was paid in full. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払済みの範囲を明細で確認します。宿泊料と、その場で追加した料金は別になる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the itemized statement to see what has been paid. Accommodation charges and charges for extras added here may be separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加したものはありません。朝食も頼まないので、宿泊料が払われているかだけ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加利用と朝食希望がなく宿泊料の支払状況だけ確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: We haven't added anything. I don't want breakfast either, so please just check whether the accommodation charge has been paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there have been no extras and you don't want breakfast, and ask only for the payment status of the accommodation charge to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。二泊分の宿泊料は支払済みです。この予約には朝食は付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've confirmed it. The accommodation charge for both nights has been paid. Breakfast is not included in this reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら安心です。私一人で明日まで泊まり、朝食は追加せず、退館時刻だけ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人で翌日まで朝食を追加せず宿泊し退館時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's a relief. I'll stay alone until tomorrow without adding breakfast. Please just tell me the checkout time.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll stay alone until tomorrow without adding breakfast and ask for the checkout time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 退館時刻は明日の午前十一時です。宿泊案内にも記しました。どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Checkout is at eleven tomorrow morning. I've also written it in the accommodation guide. Please enjoy your stay. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学を予定されている日は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided which day you'd like to visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週土曜に行きたいです。庭園で写真を撮りたいのですが、催しで入れない場所がありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週土曜に庭園撮影をしたく催しで立入不可の場所があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to come next Saturday. I want to take photos in the garden. Will any areas be closed because of an event?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to take photos in the garden next Saturday and ask whether an event will make any areas off limits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その日は一部で設営を予定しています。通常の散策区域は開く予定ですが、設営区域へは入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Setup work is planned in part of the garden that day. The normal walking areas are scheduled to open, but you won't be able to enter the setup area.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 設営の音がするなら別の日にしたいです。日曜には撤去が終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 設営音を避けたいので日曜の撤去終了を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: If there will be setup noise, I'd like to choose another day. Will dismantling be finished by Sunday?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to avoid setup noise and ask whether dismantling will be finished on Sunday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撤去の終了時刻はまだ決まっていません。今の段階で静かになるとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: The finishing time for dismantling hasn't been decided yet. At this stage, I can't say that it will be quiet.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 月曜まで滞在します。予定が確定する前に入園券を買わず、もう一度聞くことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 月曜まで滞在し入園券を買う前に予定を再確認できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm staying until Monday. Could I wait to buy an admission ticket until the schedule is finalized and ask again first?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you're staying until Monday and ask whether you can check the schedule again before buying an admission ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらの問い合わせ先へご連絡ください。設営と撤去の予定を知りたい、とお伝えいただくと分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please contact this inquiry desk. It will be clearer if you explain that you want to know the setup and dismantling schedules.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 月曜に行く場合、開園しているかも同じ窓口で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月曜の開園も同じ窓口で確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I come on Monday, can I check whether the garden will be open with the same desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the same desk can also confirm whether the garden is open on Monday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できます。日付と希望の時間帯をお伝えください。天候などによる変更もあるので、来る前の確認がお勧めです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can. Please give the date and your preferred time window. Plans can change because of weather and other factors, so we recommend checking before you come.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日曜と月曜の利用状況を確認してから日を選びます。今は土曜の入園券を買わずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日曜と月曜を確認して選び今は土曜の入園券を買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose a day after checking access arrangements for Sunday and Monday. For now, I won't buy a ticket for Saturday.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check Sunday and Monday before choosing and won't buy a Saturday admission ticket now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問い合わせ先をお渡しします。予定に合う日にお越しください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the contact details. Please visit on a day that suits your plans. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帽子を贈り物になさいますか。かぶる方の頭のサイズはお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the hat a gift? Do you know the head size of the person who'll wear it?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父への誕生日プレゼントです。サイズを聞くと気づかれそうなので、後ろで調節できる帽子を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父への贈物でサイズを直接聞かず調節できる帽子を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a birthday present for my father. Asking his size might give it away, so I'm looking for a hat that adjusts at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for an adjustable hat as a gift for your father without asking his size directly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは調節式ですが、誰にでも合うわけではありません。内側の表示に対応する範囲があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one is adjustable, but it won't fit everyone. The label inside gives the size range it accommodates.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の今の帽子を測ってきました。五十八センチなら、この表示の範囲に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父の帽子を測った五十八センチが表示範囲に入るか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I measured my father's current hat. Is fifty-eight centimeters within the range on this label?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether fifty-eight centimeters, the measurement of your father's hat, is within the labeled range. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示では五十六から六十センチです。頭の形や好みで合い方は変わるので、後で試していただくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: The label says fifty-six to sixty centimeters. Fit varies with head shape and personal preference, so it would be good for him to try it on afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 贈ったあと、本人が試して合わなかったら交換できますか。値札は外したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試着で合わない場合の交換と値札を外す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: After I give it to him, can he exchange it if it doesn't fit when he tries it on? I'd like to remove the price tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about exchanging it if it doesn't fit when tried on and say you want to remove the price tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当店では商品タグを残した未使用品が交換対象です。価格部分だけを隠す贈答用の袋を付けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Our store accepts exchanges of unused items with the product tag still attached. We can provide a gift bag that hides just the price section.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品タグを残して、価格を見せずに包んでください。交換するなら父だけ来てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品タグを残して価格を隠し父本人が交換できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please leave the product tag on and wrap it so the price isn't visible. If it needs exchanging, can my father come on his own?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to keep the product tag and hide the price, and ask whether your father can exchange it himself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この店舗では交換用の控えがあれば、ご本人でも対応できます。七日以内で、傷や汚れがないことが条件です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: At this store, he can handle the exchange himself if he has the exchange slip. It must be within seven days, and the item must have no damage or stains.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 調節式を買い、商品タグと交換用の控えも一緒に渡します。父には家の中で先に試してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 調節式を購入しタグと控えを渡して屋内で先に試着してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy the adjustable one and give him the product tag and exchange slip with it. I'll ask him to try it on indoors first.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll buy the adjustable one, pass on the tag and exchange slip, and ask him to try it on indoors first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 価格を隠してお包みします。お父様に喜んでいただけるとよいですね。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll wrap it with the price hidden. I hope your father likes it. Thank you. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧になりますか。今日はどの展示を中心に見たいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at a map? Which exhibits would you mainly like to see today?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物の中を見たいです。ただ、友人は二十分後に仕事へ戻るので、私だけ残る予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物を見たいが友人は二十分後に仕事へ戻り自分は残ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see inside the building. However, my friend has to return to work in twenty minutes, so I plan to stay on by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to see the building, but your friend will return to work in twenty minutes and you'll stay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図では、短い順路から入口へ戻れます。お二人で先にそこを回る方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, the short route takes you back to the entrance. One option is for both of you to do that route first.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は続けて奥へ行きたいのですが、途中で友人だけ出口へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は奥へ進み友人だけ途中から出口へ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to continue farther inside, but can my friend turn back toward the exit partway through on their own?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend can return to the exit partway through while you continue farther inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この分岐で別れられます。入口へ戻る矢印と、奥の展示へ向かう矢印を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go your separate ways at this junction. Please check the arrow back to the entrance and the arrow toward the exhibits farther inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が一度出て忘れ物に気づいたら、同じ入場券で戻れるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 忘れ物で出た友人が同じ券で戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: If my friend leaves and then realizes they've forgotten something, can they come back in with the same ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend can reenter with the same ticket after leaving and realizing they've forgotten something. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再入場の扱いは出口担当へ確認してください。こちらでは券の種類が分からないので、再入場できるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the reentry policy with the exit staff. I don't know which type of ticket you have here, so I can't promise reentry is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出る前に出口で聞くよう伝えます。私は最後にどの出口を使えば入口のロッカーへ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ出口で確認するよう伝え入口ロッカーに戻る出口を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friend to ask at the exit before leaving. Which exit should I use at the end to get back to the lockers by the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll tell your friend to check at the exit, and ask which exit leads back to the entrance lockers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ロッカーは入口側です。この図の戻りの矢印に沿えば入口側の出口へ出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: The lockers are on the entrance side. If you follow the return arrows on this map, you'll reach the exit on the entrance side.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に短い順路を一緒に回り、分岐で別れます。私は奥を見てから戻りの矢印でロッカーへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短い順路を一緒に回り分岐で別れ自分は奥から入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll take the short route together first, then split up at the junction. After seeing the exhibits farther inside, I'll follow the return arrows to the lockers.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take the short route together, split up at the junction, and return from the inner exhibits to the entrance yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分岐の印を付けました。友人の方にも見せてください。見学をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've marked the junction. Please show your friend as well. Enjoy your visit. Goodbye.
